facts.fact: Lucan 乘马车来接 Micah 赴舞会。
facts.anchor: I glance through the glass just in time to see a horse-drawn carriage rolling to a stop in front of my cottage.

facts.fact: Lucan 穿着合身的黑西装前来。
Lucan 特意租了南瓜形马车。
facts.anchor: I can’t believe you rented a carriage.

facts.fact: Maple 被安置在铁匠铺卧室。
facts.anchor: She’s in my bedroom, probably sleeping on my bed, cozy and safe.

facts.fact: Micah 为山上龙群与 Maple 担忧。
facts.anchor: the king has already caused harm to countless dragons just like her

facts.fact: Lucan 主张先收集确凿证据再行动。
facts.anchor: accused the king of something so horrible without proper evidence

facts.fact: 舞会面具由 Lucan 亲手所制，嵌有配镜。
Micah 第一次被伴侣这样骄傲地带入场。
facts.anchor: Nobody has ever shown me off like this before.

facts.fact: 武装守卫让 Micah 读出王权的威慑。
facts.anchor: Enjoy the feast. Marvel at my palace. But don’t forget exactly who holds the power.

facts.fact: Lucan 连喝两杯酒要“液体勇气”。
章末 Lucan 拉着 Micah 离开舞厅准备行动。
